title: Russia Says It Hit Kyiv Bridge and Two Vessels in Black Sea
detail: Russia's Defence Ministry claimed strikes on a bridge in Kyiv and on two vessels in the Black Sea. The claims come from Russian officials as reported by The Hindu and have not been independently confirmed; damage and casualties are not yet established.

media.caption: Russia says it hit Kyiv bridge and two vessels in Black Sea

title: Zelensky Asks EU for Additional ~€70bn to Sustain War Effort
detail: At a press conference in Brussels, Zelensky asked the EU for roughly €70bn (about $79bn) in additional funding to sustain Ukraine's war effort. Reported via an aggregated news feed; the request has not yet been confirmed by an EU response.
